question: Which remaining skill ecosystem lane should OpenClaw own next: public SKILL.md metadata and triggers, ClawHub publishing/trust, install security hooks, or bundle/agent-pack lifecycle?
rationale: The unresolved work defines public ecosystem contracts, security boundaries, and cross-repository ClawHub ownership that source inspection alone cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Lanes
options.body: Keep this issue open as the roadmap tracker while routing concrete implementation to the existing or new narrow metadata, trust, publishing, hook, and lifecycle issues.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers designate a complete set of canonical replacement issues for every remaining slice.

options.title: Route External Publishing Away
options.body: Move pure clawhub CLI/service publish bugs out of this repo while keeping OpenClaw-owned skill loading, install, and trust API decisions here.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Lanes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the roadmap tracker while routing concrete implementation to the existing or new narrow metadata, trust, publishing, hook, and lifecycle issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is primarily product and trust-boundary scope, and this history ties steipete to VISION.md, ClawHub, and skill security direction.
